headline: As an NDA this is genuinely mutual and clean (no non-compete, no-hire or residuals clause), but it says nothing about patient data and cannot stand in for the HIPAA flow-down Harrington's BAA requires.

findings.title: NDA is silent on patient data and is not a BAA flow-down
findings.quote: 1.1 The Parties wish to exchange information in connection with a proposed and ongoing engagement of Mr. Ortiz as an independent contractor providing data engineering services to AtliQ (the "Purpose").
findings.explanation: The Purpose names data engineering services but not Harrington, patient data, PHI or HIPAA. Nothing in the NDA says what data Ortiz will receive. The signed Harrington NDA (§2.3) excludes PHI altogether until a BAA is signed, and the Harrington BAA draft (§4.3) requires each Subcontractor to agree in writing, before any access to PHI, to the same restrictions AtliQ accepts. A general confidentiality promise is not that. The missing flow-down is reported as the main finding in the contractor-agreement brief; this NDA adds no protection for it.

register_refs.quote: Protected Health Information, as defined at 45 C.F.R. § 160.103, is excluded from this Agreement and shall be disclosed only after execution of a Business Associate Agreement between the Parties.

extra_quotes.quote: 4.3 Flow-Down. In accordance with 45 C.F.R. §§ 164.502(e)(1)(ii) and 164.308(b)(2), Business Associate shall ensure that each Subcontractor agrees in writing, prior to any access to PHI, to the same restrictions, conditions and requirements that apply to Business Associate under this BAA.

findings.title: NDA confidentiality clock does not match the contractor agreement or the BAA
findings.quote: 5.1 This Agreement applies to information disclosed during the two (2) years following the Effective Date. The obligations in Sections 3 and 4 continue for three (3) years after the end of that period.
findings.explanation: The NDA protects information disclosed in the two years after signing and runs for three more years (about five years from signing at most). The contractor agreement says its confidentiality clause survives three years after termination (§7.4), and says the NDA applies as well (§7.3). The Harrington BAA's duties run until all PHI has been returned or destroyed and certified (§11.1). The three documents give three different end dates for the same information.

extra_quotes.quote: 7.4 This Section 7 survives termination for three (3) years.
